summary.title: Postdoctoral research fellow
summary.org: National Human Genome Research Institute, National Institutes of Health
summary.detail: Manage six projects, including an FDA-regulated pharmacology trial. Run a study of how AI review changes trust in genetic risk results, under principal investigator Susan Persky. Teach R and Quarto to colleagues.

summary.title: PhD in Psychology and Master of Public Policy
summary.detail: Ran my dissertation, six preregistered studies on trust in medical AI. Managed five research assistants across six or seven concurrent projects. Taught Psychology of Technology as instructor of record and received the 2023 Graduate Student Teaching Award. Coordinated the department research pool, where yield rose 50% over the prior year.

summary.title: Master's in Psychology, General Experimental
summary.detail: Wrote a preregistered thesis on obedience to computer authority. Worked as a data analyst in Institutional Research on more than 100,000 student records, building dashboards administrators used. Coordinated an applied social psychology lab and trained 14 lab assistants.

summary.title: Research assistant and lab manager
summary.detail: Managed the schedules and reviews of 15 research assistants as lab manager, and wrote Excel macros and Praat scripts to process speech data.
